name: Product Launch
summary: A launch page for an app, SaaS, gadget, course or any product: an animated aurora hero with a word-by-word headline and a CSS laptop + phone mockup whose screen cycles through three app screens, a feature marquee, a bento grid with a pointer spotlight, a sticky-phone 'how it works', optional story photo, placeholder pricing, FAQ and a full-colour call to action. Built almost entirely from CSS/SVG art, so it looks finished even with no photos.

sections.name: header
sections.what: Sticky glass header: initial mark + business name, 4 anchor links (desktop), 'Get started' button that jumps to the final call to action
sections.edit: Keep the nav links in step with the sections: if you delete pricing (or any section), delete its link here and in the footer

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Aurora background (4 blurred SVG shapes that drift), 'New' badge link, h1 revealed word by word with an accent marker behind the <em> words, lead line, primary button ({{email_href}}) + 'See how it works', then the device mockup: a laptop showing a dashboard and a phone that cycles through home, messages and schedule screens, with two floating cards
sections.edit: Rewrite the h1 as the product's single biggest promise (6 to 10 words; keep one <em> around 1 to 3 key words, with no punctuation right after it). Rewrite the badge (or delete the <a class="hero__badge">) and the lead with what it is and who it is for. Point the primary button at the real sign-up/download/contact link. Leave the mockups alone: they are generic and take the style colours automatically

sections.name: glance
sections.what: Endless marquee of six short feature phrases in the display font
sections.edit: Replace with 4 to 8 real two-to-five word features; keep the alternating glance__item / glance__item--soft classes

sections.name: features
sections.what: Bento grid of five tiles with drawn art: big lead tile (bar chart board), speed gauge, devices, privacy lock, connections graph. Pointer spotlight on hover
sections.edit: One tile per real feature: rewrite each h3 and p. The biggest tile (tile--lead) gets the most important feature. Delete a tile only from the end (tile--connect) so the grid stays balanced

sections.name: how
sections.what: Three numbered steps beside a sticky phone; the step in view lights up and the phone shows its screen (sign up, set up, results)
sections.edit: Rewrite the three h3 + p with the real steps (keep three, keep data-step 0/1/2 and the matching phone screens)

sections.name: story
sections.what: Optional photo (slot about) with a dotted offset frame, the story behind the business, signature line
sections.edit: Write two short paragraphs in the owner's words about why it exists. If there is no story, delete the whole section

sections.name: pricing
sections.what: Three plan cards (middle one marked Recommended) with '$ —' placeholder prices and generic feature lists; a swipe strip on phones
sections.edit: Only with real plans and real prices from the owner: fill names, prices, lists and button links. Otherwise delete the section and its nav and footer links

sections.name: faq
sections.what: Sticky heading with an email link + accordion of 5 questions (first one open; all open without JavaScript)
sections.edit: Replace with the owner's real questions and answers (3 to 7). Keep the id/aria-controls pairs unique (faq-q1/faq-a1 ...)

sections.name: cta
sections.what: Full accent-colour panel with rings and the business initial, big h2, one line, two buttons ({{email_href}} and {{phone_href}})
sections.edit: Rewrite the lead with what happens after someone gets in touch. Swap the buttons for the real sign-up or store links; delete the phone button if there is no phone

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Brand, tagline, anchor links, email and phone links, copyright and back-to-top
sections.edit: Keep contact tokens; match links to the sections that remain

photo_slots.hint: the product in use, the workspace, or the people who make it (4:3 crop)

behaviors: aurora shapes drift slowly (transform only; paused off screen and for reduced motion)
headline words reveal one by one
phone screen cycles every 4 s with matching progress dots
pointer spotlight on bento tiles (mouse only)
how-it-works steps highlight with IntersectionObserver and switch the sticky phone screen (tap a step too)
sticky glass header and scroll progress bar from motion.js
style_notes: Works with every style: all colours come from the six theme colours (device glass is fixed near-black). Strongest with midnight-neon, clinical-clean, soft-pastel, editorial-serif and dark-luxury. Tested at 390 and 1280 px with midnight-neon, editorial-serif, neo-brutalist, high-contrast-sport, soft-pastel, poster-bold and dark-luxury. The aurora uses the accent plus two hue-shifted copies of it (+14 and -26 degrees, set in the hidden svg.aurora__defs filters). Each device mockup is a single role=img with a label; the aurora and the cta rings are aria-hidden. In styles with uppercase headings keep the h1 short.
